reason: A starter template for developing DeepSeek Harness plugins, demonstrating configuration, model-callable tools, events, optional services and hooks, testing, and browser UI registrations.

summaries.zh: 用于开发 DeepSeek Harness 插件的入门模板，示范配置、模型可调用工具、事件、可选服务与钩子以及浏览器界面注册。
summaries.en: A starter template for DeepSeek Harness plugin development that demonstrates configuration, model-callable tools, events, optional services and hooks, testing, and browser UI registrations.

capabilities: Provides typed configuration with live reads and browser settings UI
Registers events and multiple browser interface surfaces
Includes optional service and tool permission-gate examples disabled by default
